verdict.rationale: A live llms.txt was found at phaser.io/llms.txt (an examples-API index) and Phaser Studio publishes agent-oriented docs/MCP server pages (phaser.io/agent/mcp) explicitly for connecting coding agents, but the more commonly probed docs.phaser.io/llms.txt returns 404 and the site root 403s non-browser clients, requiring a browser UA and precise deep links to succeed. Missing for 10: a consistently discoverable llms.txt across the main docs domain, no 403/404 friction for automated agent fetches, and independent confirmation that agents can reliably ingest these docs.
